title: Synthesis and characterization of thiol-stabilized gold nanoparticles appended to bis(pyrazole) pyridine for fabrication of rectangular nano/microstripes and their spin crossover and SERS studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31461-31470
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05105C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ajay kumar Botcha, Yemineni S. L. V. Narayana
Thiol-stabilized gold nanoparticles linked to bis(pyrazole)pyridine ligands were assembled into rectangular nano/microstripes using lithographically controlled wetting, enabling combined spin crossover and SERS studies on a single platform.
